تصطبنون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَبِنُونَ (taṣṭabinūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# تُصْطَبَنُونَ (tuṣṭabanūna) /tusˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
